_comment: The text-model chain, as DATA so automation can rewrite it safely. Order matters and encodes a judgment about envelope reliability — see the comment above TEXT_MODELS in shared.mjs. agents/pi-update.mjs replaces entries here only when an id has broken (rotated out of pi's registry, or — for free entries — no longer free); it never reorders a working chain. Edit by hand freely. An entry with "paid": true is one whose cost is DELIBERATE: model-check.mjs won't call it broken for billing money, and the free entries beneath it are its fallback if the key runs dry.

text.why: Paid head, $0.14/$0.28 per M tokens as of pi 0.84.2 — 47th cheapest of the 327 paid OpenRouter models pi knows, and the cheapest that is both coding-tuned and a current frontier-family model. Cheaper entries exist; they trade away the reasoning the Builder leans on. Falls through to the free entries below on any error, including an exhausted balance.
Replaced `openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash:free` (missing) automatically; verified by model-probe against pi at the time of the swap.
OpenRouter reports structured_outputs support — an imperfect but real proxy for envelope discipline.
Structured-output support, different provider family than the entries above.
Replaced `openrouter/openai/gpt-oss-20b:free` (missing) automatically; verified by model-probe against pi at the time of the swap.
Coding-tuned, and the fourth distinct provider family in the chain.
Capable but envelope-unreliable (18 of 42 sessions unusable) — worth having only once everything above it has failed.
